IDF Spokesperson:

Earlier today (Wednesday), a female IDF soldier was seriously wounded, a combat officer was moderately wounded, and two additional soldiers were moderately wounded as a result of an explosive drone strike in southern Lebanon.

Additionally, a combat officer was lightly wounded and two additional soldiers were lightly wounded in the incident.

The female soldier and the soldiers were evacuated for medical treatment at the hospital, and their families have been notified.
